lines.text: Here's what's inside the gingerbread contest kit. Judge score cards, two to a page. People's Choice ballots, eight per page. A tally sheet for up to three judges. And certificates for kids, teens and adults. Fifteen pages. Instant download. Tap the link, and grab it on Etsy.

Can your kids open the Pie Safe before dinner? Grandma Hazel locked four pies away, and mixed up the code. Four clues. Each one gives a digit. Level one for ages six to nine. Level two for ten and up. Hint cards, an answer key, and certificates. About forty-five minutes of play. No phone needed. Tap the link, and grab it on Etsy.
